title: 02.01 - How to contact the survey owner
intent: Explain how participants can contact the owner or organiser of a survey.
short_answer: You can contact the survey owner using the Contact option on the right-side panel of the survey page.
procedure: Use the available contact information or form to reach the survey owner.
important_conditions: The survey owner is responsible for survey-specific questions, deadlines, access, and content.
If the contact option is not available and your issue is technical, use the EUSurvey support form where appropriate.
